name: nitrate
description: nitrate clanker plugin for packet sync and AI media collaboration

interface.shortDescription: Run AI media packet work from the clanker.
interface.longDescription: nitrate is the plugin-first control layer for agency AI media production. Leaders create and push client packets. Creators pull assigned packets into their clanker workspace, update status, and sync returned media with prompts, tool context, and notes attached.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use nitrate as the main entry point. Start with nitrate_next_action, then help the user create packets, pull assigned work, update status, or sync returned media.
